_comment: FR-EQ-018 气球模第一稳定边界 —— 2026-09-18 实测。门：$FYLITE_KERNEL/rust/fylite/src/stability.rs::tests

model.equation: s-alpha ballooning (Connor-Hastie-Taylor 1978): d/dtheta[(1+h^2) F'] + alpha (cos theta + h sin theta) F = 0,  h = s theta - alpha sin theta
model.criterion: Newcomb node criterion: a zero of F in (0, theta_max] = unstable
model.state: F and P = (1+h^2) F' (P stays O(1) as 1+h^2 grows like theta^2)

sign_anchor.note: alpha = 0: ((1+s^2 theta^2) F')' = 0 with F'(0) = 0 leaves F == 1

truncation_s1.upstream_claim: 16 偏低 3.6 % —— 方向相反、量级不同：上游的「截断」不是 theta_max = N pi

refusal.precise: 扫得到边界时照常给答案
